/bin/zsh -lc "cat > generated_tests.keel <<'EOF'
// Add regression tests here.

test \"equal timestamps are never fresh\" {
    assert is_fresh(0, 0) == false
    assert is_fresh(1, 1) == false
    assert is_fresh(-1, -1) == false
    assert is_fresh(9223372036854775807, 9223372036854775807) == false
    assert is_fresh(-9223372036854775807 - 1, -9223372036854775807 - 1) == false
}

test \"adjacent timestamps obey strict ordering\" {
    assert is_fresh(0, 1)
    assert is_fresh(1, 0) == false
    assert is_fresh(-1, 0)
    assert is_fresh(0, -1) == false
    assert is_fresh(-2, -1)
    assert is_fresh(-1, -2) == false
    assert is_fresh(41, 42)
    assert is_fresh(42, 41) == false
    assert is_fresh(-42, -41)
    assert is_fresh(-41, -42) == false
}

test \"extreme adjacent timestamps preserve ordering\" {
    let lowest = -9223372036854775807 - 1
    let highest = 9223372036854775807
    assert is_fresh(lowest, lowest + 1)
    assert is_fresh(lowest + 1, lowest) == false
    assert is_fresh(highest - 1, highest)
    assert is_fresh(highest, highest - 1) == false
}

test \"wide signed differences preserve ordering\" {
    let lowest = -9223372036854775807 - 1
    let highest = 9223372036854775807
    assert is_fresh(lowest, highest)
    assert is_fresh(highest, lowest) == false
    assert is_fresh(lowest, 0)
    assert is_fresh(0, lowest) == false
    assert is_fresh(-1, highest)
    assert is_fresh(highest, -1) == false
    assert is_fresh(0, highest)
    assert is_fresh(highest, 0) == false
    assert is_fresh(lowest, -1)
    assert is_fresh(-1, lowest) == false
    assert is_fresh(-123456789, 987654321)
    assert is_fresh(987654321, -123456789) == false
}

test \"ordering retains bits above 32 bit range\" {
    assert is_fresh(2147483647, 2147483648)
    assert is_fresh(2147483648, 2147483647) == false
    assert is_fresh(-2147483649, -2147483648)
    assert is_fresh(-2147483648, -2147483649) == false
    assert is_fresh(1, 4294967297)
    assert is_fresh(4294967297, 1) == false
    assert is_fresh(-4294967297, -1)
    assert is_fresh(-1, -4294967297) == false
    assert is_fresh(9007199254740992, 9007199254740993)
    assert is_fresh(9007199254740993, 9007199254740992) == false
    assert is_fresh(-9007199254740993, -9007199254740992)
    assert is_fresh(-9007199254740992, -9007199254740993) == false
}
EOF
python3 workflow.py validate"
